title: Owner-user guide preferences
description: Capability guides.preferences. A single record per current owner user per host, shared across devices; individual seen tips remain device-local. No expiry, deletion, or cross-host replication.

skippedThrough.description: Semantic version of the desktop whose guides were answered; null resets the shared answered-through flag.

updatedAt.description: Authoritative host write time; null when never saved.

guidesPreferencePut.description: Owner-full write. Unknown fields and client updatedAt are ignored; the server supplies updatedAt. Cannot select another user.
